jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our Data Processing & Analytics Team as a Backend and DevOps Engineer, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aJunior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)In this role, you will help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and backend services powering our data analytics platform. You’ll sit at the intersection of backend software development and modern platform operations (DevOps), working closely with data engineers and analysts to ensure our analytics ecosystem is performant, reliable, and observable.If you enjoy automating deployments, and managing modern data stores in containerized environments, this is a great opportunity to jumpstart your career.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- DevOps Engineering: Contribute to the development and maintenance using Ansible, Gitlab-CI, Helm etc.- Database Management: Assist in provisioning, configuring, and maintaining operational databases, specifically MongoDB (NoSQL) and InfluxDB (time-series).- Platform Operations & Containerization: Help manage containerized deployments on Kubernetes(RKE) and deploy applications using Helm charts.- Observability & Monitoring: Set up and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting configurations using Prometheus and Grafana to ensure platform uptime and health.- Version Control & Shell Automation: Use Git for version control and workflow management, and write basic Unix shell scripts (Bash) for automation and routine system tasks.- Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, document setup procedures, and collaborate with senior platform engineers to troubleshoot infrastructure issues.Desired skills and qualifications- An academic degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.- Technical competencies- Backend Programming: Foundational programming skills in at least one or two core languages used across our ecosystem (Go, Python, Java, or Kotlin).- Knowledge of DevOps : Ansible, Terraform, Gitlab-CI, Helm, OCI, ArgoCD.- Version Control: Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, pull requests, versioning workflows).- Linux / Unix Basics: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems and comfort navigating the CLI or writing basic shell scripts.- Problem-Solving Mindset: Eager to learn modern infrastructure practices and systematically debug issues across backend code and data pipelines.- Soft Skills:- Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving.- Ability to work collaboratively within an agile, multicultural team environment.- Self-motivated, with a proactive attitude toward learning and skill development.- Nice to have :- CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD (Certified About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support our team “Supp. Engineering Trsp./Miss. GE”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aTestability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.Your locationLocated about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.Key purpose  - Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.Structure and reporting relationship The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  Internal Communications- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  External Communications- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.Integration Communications- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.Social Media & Content Creation- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.Stakeholder Engagement- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.Additional / special features of the role - Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration EuropeDesirable- Must: German native or fully proficient- Must: English level B2- Desirable: French- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

requiredExperience & Background- 5+ years of relevant experiences, ideally a mix of consulting and industry experiences- Prior experience in a PE-backed or transformation-intensive environment preferred- Proven track record of managing complex, cross-functional projects in an international contextSkills & Competencies- Strong project management and organizational skills with a structured, jobs.occupation: AGGP2027 – Graduate A400M MRO Engineering (Ingenieur/in - Service/Instandhaltung)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job description**AGGP2027 – Graduate A400M MRO Engineering **Start date - October 2027Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.During the two years**, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey,** covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.** What you will be doing**You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of Graduate A400M MRO Engineering and can expect to be involved in the following:1. Translate approved maintenance documentation into shop floor documentation.2. Quantify the costs (effort, materials) of the work, provide build processes and work orders3. Being the interface between the maintenance organization and other stakeholders such as customer/CAMO/Program office.4. Provide technical solutions for issues arising during MRO activities.5. jobs.occupation: QA Automation Engineer (IDEA Ultimate QA) (m/f/d) (Qualitätsfachmann/-frau - Fertigungsprüftechnik)
jobs.description: At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers and businesses to grow, discover, and create.IntelliJ IDEA revolutionized the Java development tool market back in 2001, becoming the first IDE to offer automated code refactoring. It continues to drive innovation in software development, making thousands of programmers more productive every day. In addition to Java, IntelliJ IDEA includes various development tools for other prominent languages such as Ruby, Groovy, Scala, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, PHP, and Kotlin.About the teamThe IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate team is responsible for supporting a wide range of enterprise frameworks, data-access stacks, and application servers in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. This includes technologies such as Spring (including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, and others), Jakarta EE, Quarkus, Micronaut, various reactive and data-access libraries, and popular application servers like Tomcat, WildFly, and Jetty. We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.What you’ll doCore responsibilities:- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.- Contribute to frameworks and tools with product-specific extensions as needed.- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.- Participate in release quality assessments.- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.- Do manual QA activities when needed.- Participate in the test documentation creation.- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.- Share automation best practices with the team.- Work with the tooling team to adopt new frameworks and practices.What we’re looking forRequired skills:- Proven experience in test automation.- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.- Experience with test frameworks like JUnit or TestNG.- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).- Version control experience (Git).- Proficiency in spoken and written English.- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.- Strong teamwork skills.- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.Nice to have:- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.**Why join JetBrains?** - Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.- Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.- Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family- Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.- Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. - Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.- Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.- Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.- Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.- Internal events.
